attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the persistent OpenWrt gateway. Trusted clients node2/node4 use 192.168.10.0/24; guest node3 uses 192.168.20.0/24. Both networks receive DHCP, DNS, and internet access through node1. app.home.test resolves to node2 at 192.168.10.10:8080; trusted access succeeds and guest access is rejected. All four nodes were restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot identities.
